concerns.text: The edge case 'How does the system handle framework structures with periodic boundary conditions that exceed the 7 GB RAM limit during graph construction? (System must sample or chunk the structure)' has no backing functional requirement. FR-002 defines graph construction but says nothing about memory-exceeding structures or the sample/chunk behavior. Add an FR (e.g. FR-019) anchored to US-1 covering this behavior, or fold it into FR-002.
